name: SDK coarse-grained
references: W. Shinoda, R. DeVane, M. L. Klein, Mol. Simul. 33, 27 (2007)

atom_types.name: OA_bOA_aOA_dOA_iOA
atom_types.description: SDK OA: -CH2OH, the hydroxyl end of a PEG chain (LAMMPS examples/PACKAGES/cgspica/peg-verlet)

atom_types.name: EO_bEO_aEO_dEO_iEO
atom_types.description: SDK EO: -CH2OCH2-, an ethylene-oxide unit (LAMMPS examples/PACKAGES/cgspica/peg-verlet)

atom_types.name: SO4_bSO4_aSO4_dSO4_iSO4
atom_types.description: SDK SO4: -OSO3-, the sulfate of SDS (LAMMPS examples/PACKAGES/cgspica/sds-monolayer)

atom_types.name: SOD_bSOD_aSOD_dSOD_iSOD
atom_types.description: SDK SOD: Na+ with three waters (LAMMPS examples/PACKAGES/cgspica/sds-monolayer)

notes: converted from moltemplate by CAPS; rules keep moltemplate's order (the last matching rule wins)
CAPS correction: beads have no element (the converter guessed Al, Ca, K, Si from bead masses)
cut-off 15 A, the model's (LAMMPS SDK / SPICA examples: lj/sdk 15.0); the source file's 12 A leaves W water at 0.85 g/cm3
bead charges from the source's parameter file (sdk_lipids.prm: NC, NH +1; PH, PHE -1; others 0)

CAPS extension: PH takes PHE's bond and angle terms (the source gives the phosphate's bonded terms under PHE only, including the PC head's NC-PHE bond and GL-PHE-NC angle); PH keeps its own non-bonded pairs
relative permittivity 80 (LAMMPS's SDK SDS example: ionic beads +-0.1118 e = 1/sqrt(80))

CAPS extension: SDK beads for PEG (OA, EO) and SDS (SO4, SOD) with their pairs, bonds and angles from LAMMPS's SDK / SPICA examples (examples/PACKAGES/cgspica: peg-verlet, sds-monolayer); their CM, CT, CT2 and W terms equal this file's
validation: lj/sdk 9-6 / 12-4 forms are not evaluated by CAPS yet.
